name: codelieutenant/scylla-driver-async-adapters
description: Optional event-loop adapters for the ScyllaDB PHP driver (Revolt, Amp, ReactPHP, Swoole)

suggest.ext-swoole: Await Cassandra\Future inside Swoole coroutines via Cassandra\Async\Swoole
suggest.amphp/amp: Await Cassandra\Future as an Amp\Future via Cassandra\Async\Amp
suggest.react/event-loop: Await Cassandra\Future as a React promise via Cassandra\Async\ReactPhp
